#define call_int_hook(FUNC, IRC, ...) ({			\ /* <=== security/security.c:708:720:call_int_hook:3 */ 
	int RC = IRC;						\
	do {							\
		struct security_hook_list *P;			\
								\
		hlist_for_each_entry(P, &security_hook_heads.FUNC, list) { \
			RC = P->hook.FUNC(__VA_ARGS__);		\
			if (RC != 0)				\
				break;				\
		}						\
	} while (0);						\
	RC;							\
})
